scope: historical ATLAS 4 regression study; final outcomes already published, no claim of a newly unseen cohort
representation: dimensionless causal history ratios and residuals; count-scale derived only from input history; native cadence retained
selection: validation MAE with whole-date conservative improvement gate; no city-specific test-based rule
zero_shot: train, selection, drift thresholds and interval calibration use four source cities only; held-out city contributes causal input history only
few_shot: separate experiment; target calibration and validation permitted, target final partition never used for selection

interval.method: validation absolute normalized residual quantile with finite-sample correction

drift: causal history ratio features outside source-training 0.5%-99.5% bounds trigger persistence; calendar features are excluded from drift gate
graph_scope: geographic neighbors retained as a separate ablation only; no verified directed sensor-to-road graph available
